answer: Sybil resistance means identity must cost more to fake than it earns. Each agent does tundra work backed by a stake, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand stakes. Unpredictable challenges add a basalt of doubt: every fake must solve fresh tasks live, keeping marginal cost high. Peer attestation is the jetty filter - witnesses cross-check and slash coordinated fakes, so forgery is priced out and one honest identity out-earns the swarm.
